description: This file defines the Atlas class for managing texture atlases, including loading, creating, and handling texture regions from JSON atlas files and images. It also contains command-line interface code for generating atlases from PNG images.

classes.name: Atlas
classes.description: Manages texture atlases, including loading from JSON files, creating new atlases from images, and providing access to texture regions.

methods.name: _get_filename
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the Atlas instance.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Atlas object with a filename and loads the atlas data.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Provides dictionary-like access to textures by key.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Loads the atlas data from the JSON file, including textures and regions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new texture atlas from a list of image files, saving the atlas JSON and PNG files.
